description: Overrides beyond the shared preset: automerge, lockfile maintenance, the ignorePaths and vulnerability-alert defaults common to every repository built from this component template. Individual packageRules document their own exceptions.

packageRules.description: The go directive is OWNED by devbox-update (ci-workflows v2.10.0): it aligns go.mod to the toolchain triple in the same PR as devbox.lock. Renovate leaves `go` alone so the three can never disagree.
